caseName: Ross Lumber Co. v. Hughes Lumber Co.

opinions.text: October 11, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied. Mr. John E. Hall, Mr. Warren Grice and Mr. Charles J. Bloch for petitioner. Mr. Edward de Graffenried for respondent.
